text.16zisnr: What this site collects, why, and what you can ask for. Short version: very little, and nothing is sold.
text.17m0y7: The Light Orb is run by Carla Tres García (NIF 39934017Z), a sole trader (the data controller). Address: Avenida Duque de Loulé 91, Lisboa, Portugal. Contact: trescarla@gmail.com.
text.jzyvmm: We count visits with GoatCounter, a privacy-friendly analytics service that sets no cookies and does not track you across sites. It records the page address, referrer, browser type, screen size and an approximate country, without storing your IP address. If your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, nothing is counted at all. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in knowing which pages are used.
text.1lsgia1: If you join early access (or the waitlist) we keep your email address, the name you give if any, the date, where you signed up (for example "footer") and your browser language — nothing else. It is stored in Cloudflare Workers KV, the owner receives one notification email about each new sign-up (sent through Resend), and it is used only to tell you when pieces and Studio updates open. Your display name, designs and saved items stay in your browser. Legal basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time by writing to trescarla@gmail.com; we then delete your address.
text.1g6zrok: When you ask the guide Orb a question, the text of the conversation and the page you are on are sent through our Cloudflare Worker to Anthropic, which generates the reply. We do not store or log these conversations. Anthropic processes them as our service provider under its own commercial terms. Please do not share personal information in the conversation.
text.1ynsa5e: Speech recognition and speech synthesis are done by your browser. Depending on your browser, the recognised audio may be processed by its maker (for example Google or Apple). We never receive or keep your voice.
text.buykzp: The site uses your browser's local storage to remember your preferences (sound, voice), saved items, your display name and your designs, plus short-lived session storage for scroll position. This stays on your device; we cannot see it. You can clear it from your browser settings.
text.yf1sxy: GitHub (site hosting), Cloudflare (Worker and waitlist storage), Resend (sign-up notification emails to the owner), GoatCounter (visit counts) and Anthropic (Orb replies). Some of them are based in the United States; transfers rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.
text.25w4ty: Waitlist emails are kept until the pieces open and the announcement is sent, or until you ask us to delete them, and in any case no longer than two years. Visit counts are aggregated.
text.cvq2bi: Under the GDPR you can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to processing, and withdraw consent, by writing to trescarla@gmail.com. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, aepd.es).
